ayahs.textEnglish: Ta. Sin, Mim.
THESE ARE MESSAGES of the divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوْنُوْا مُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: La‘allaka bākhi‘un nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Wouldst thou, perhaps, torment thyself to death [with grief] because they [who live around thee] refuse to believe [in it]?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خٰضِعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In nasya' nunazzil ‘alaihim minas-samā'i āyatan fa ẓallat a‘nāquhum lahā khāḍi‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Had We so willed, We could have sent down unto them a message from the skies, so that their necks would [be forced to] bow down before it in humility.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ya'tīhim min żikrim minar-raḥmāni muḥdaṡin illā kānū ‘anhu mu‘riḍīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But We have not willed it:] and so, whenever there comes unto them any fresh reminder from the Most Gracious, they [who are blind of heart] always - turn their backs upon it:

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا فَسَيَأْتِيْهِمْ اَنْۢبـٰۤؤُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faqad każżabū fa saya'tīhim ambā'u mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: thus, indeed, have they given the lie (to this message as well). But [in time] they will come to understand what it was that they were wont to deride!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنْۢبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau ilal-arḍi kam ambatnā fīhā min kulli zaujin karīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they, then, never considered the earth - how much of every noble kind [of life] We have caused to grow thereon?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًۗ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this, behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ نَادٰى رَبُّكَ مُوْسٰٓى اَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż nādā rabbuka mūsā ani'til-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: HENCE, [remember how it was] when thy Sustainer summoned Moses: “Go unto those evil doing people.
the people of Pharaoh, who refuse to be con­scious of Me!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اَنْ يُّكَذِّبُوْنِ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi innī akhāfu ay yukażżibūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: He answered: “O my Sustainer! Behold, I fear that they will give me the lie,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَضِيْقُ صَدْرِيْ وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِيْ فَاَرْسِلْ اِلٰى هٰرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaḍīqu ṣadrī wa lā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa arsil ilā hārūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and then my breast will be straitened and my tongue will not be free: send, then, [this Thy command] to Aaron.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْۢبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنْ يَّقْتُلُوْنِ  ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahum ‘alayya żambun fa akhāfu ay yaqtulūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Moreover, they keep a grave charge [pending] against me, and I fear that they will slay me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۚفَاذْهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla kallā, fażhabā bi'āyātinā innā ma‘akum mustami‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: “Not so, indeed! Go forth, then, both of you, with Our messages: verify, We shall be with you, listening [to your call]!

ayahs.textArabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُوْلَآ اِنَّا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'tiyā fir‘auna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And go, both of you, unto Pharaoh and say, ‘Behold, we bear a message from the Sustainer of all the worlds:
Let the children of Israel go with us!’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِيْنَا وَلِيْدًا وَّلَبِثْتَ فِيْنَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdaw wa labiṡta fīnā min ‘umurika sinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But when Moses had delivered his message, Pharaoh] said: “Did we not bring thee up among us when thou wert a child? And didst thou not spend among us years of thy [later] life?

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِيْ فَعَلْتَ وَاَنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fa‘alta fa‘latakal-latī fa‘alta wa anta minal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet thou didst commit that [heinous] deed of thine, and [hast thus shown that] thou art one of the ingrate!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ اِذًا وَّاَنَا۠ مِنَ الضَّاۤلِّيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fa‘altuhā iżaw wa ana minaḍ-ḍāllīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Replied [Moses]: “I committed it while I was still going astray;

ayahs.textArabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِيْ رَبِّيْ حُكْمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa farartu minkum lammā khiftukum fa wahaba lī rabbī ḥukmaw wa ja‘alanī minal-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and I fled from you because I feared you. But [since] then my Sustainer has endowed me with the ability to judge [between right and wrong], and has made me one of [His] message-­bearers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنْ عَبَّدْتَّ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tilka ni‘matun tamunnuhā ‘alayya an ‘abbatta banī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [as for] that favour of which thou so tauntingly remindest me - [was it not] due to thy having enslaved the children of Israel?”
Said Pharaoh: “And what [and who] is that ‘Sustainer of all the worlds’?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۗ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā, in kuntum mūqinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Moses] answered: “[He is] the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them: if you would but [allow yourselves to] be convinced!”
Said [Pharaoh] unto those around him: “Did you hear [what he said]?”
[And Moses] continued: “[He is] your Sus­tainer, [too,] as well as the Sustainer of your fore­fathers of old!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوْلَكُمُ الَّذِيْٓ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla inna rasūlakumul-lażī ursila ilaikum lamajnūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Pharaoh] exclaimed: “Behold, [this] your ‘apostle’ who [claims that he] has been sent unto you is mad indeed!

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۗ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbul-masyriqi wal-magribi wa mā bainahumā, in kuntum ta‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But Moses] went on: “[He of whom I speak is] the Sustainer of the east and the west and of all that is between the two”- as you would know] if you would but use your reason!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَىِٕنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلٰهًا غَيْرِيْ لَاَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُوْنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla la'inittakhażta ilāhan gairī la'aj‘alannaka minal-masjūnīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Pharaoh]: “Indeed, if thou choose to worship any deity other than me, I shall most cer­tainly throw thee into prison!
Said he: “Even if I should bring about before thee something that clearly shows the truth?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهٖٓ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fa'ti bihī in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Pharaoh] answered: “Produce it, then, if thou art a man of truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَلْقٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa alqā ‘aṣāhu fa iżā hiya ṡu‘bānum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon [Moses] threw down his staff - and lo! it was a serpent, plainly visible;

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاۤءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa naza‘a yadahū fa iżā hiya baiḍā'u lin-nāẓirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and he drew forth his hand - and lo! it appeared [shining] white to the beholders.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهٗٓ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla lil-mala'i ḥaulahū inna hāżā lasāḥirun ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [pharaoh] unto the great ones around him: “Verily, this is indeed a sorcerer of great knowledge

ayahs.textArabic: يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهٖۖ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yurīdu ay yukhrijakum min arḍikum bisiḥrih(ī), fa māżā ta'murūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery. What, then, do you advise?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِى الْمَدَاۤىِٕنِ حٰشِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū arjih wa akhāhu wab‘aṡ fil-madā'ini ḥāsyirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “Let him and his brother wait a while, and send unto all cities heralds
who shall assemble before thee all sorcerers of great knowl­edge”
And so the sorcerers were assembled at a set time on a certain day,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa qīla lin-nāsi hal antum mujtami‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and the people were asked: Are you all present,

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textEnglish: so that we might follow [in the footsteps of] the sorcerers if it is they who prevail?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَىِٕنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'as-saḥaratu qālū lifir‘auna a'inna lanā la'ajran in kunnā naḥnul-gālibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now when the sorcerers came, they said unto Pharaoh: “Verily, we ought to have a great reward if it is we who prevail.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla na‘am wa innakum iżal laminal-muqarrabīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered he: “Yea - and, verily, in that case you shall be among those who are near unto me.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰٓى اَلْقُوْا مَآ اَنْتُمْ مُّلْقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mulqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] Moses said unto them: “Throw whatever you are going to throw!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa alqau ḥibālahum wa ‘iṣiyyahum wa qālū bi‘izzati fir‘auna innā lanaḥnul-gālibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon they threw their [magic ropes and their staffs, and said: “By Pharaoh’s might, behold, it is we indeed who have prevailed!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَلْقٰى مُوْسٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa alqā mūsā ‘aṣāhu fa iżā hiya talqafu mā ya'fikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] then Moses threw his staff - and lo! it swallowed up all their deceptions.
And down fell the sorcerers, prostrating them­selves in adoration,
[and] exclaimed: “We have come to believe in the Sustainer of all the worlds,
the Sustainer of Moses and Aaron!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيْرُكُمُ الَّذِيْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَۚ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ەۗ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla āmantum lahū qabla an āżana lakum, innahū lakabīrukumul-lażī ‘allamakumus-siḥr(a), fa lasaufa ta‘lamūn(a), la'uqaṭṭi‘anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilāfiw wa la'uṣallibannakum  ajma'īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Pharaoh]: “Have you come to believe in him ere I have given you permission? Verily, he must be your master who has taught you magic! But in time you shall come to know [my revenge]: most certainly shall I cut off your hands and your feet in great numbers, because of [your] perverseness, and shall most certainly crucify you in great numbers, all together!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖاِنَّآ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū lā ḍair(a), innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “No harm [canst thou do to us]: verily, unto our Sustainer do we turn!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَآ اَنْ كُنَّآ اَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۗ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naṭma‘u ay yagfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwalal-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, we [but] ardently desire that our Sustainer forgive us our faults in return for our having been foremost among the believers!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلٰى مُوْسٰىٓ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْٓ اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa auḥainā ilā mūsā an asri bi‘ibādī innakum muttaba‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [there came a time when] We inspired Moses thus: “Go forth with My servants by night: for, behold, you will he pursued!”
And Pharaoh sent heralds unto all cities,
[bidding them to call out his troops and to proclaim:] “Behold, these [children of Israel] are but a contemptible band;
but they are indeed filled with hatred of us
seeing that we are, verily, a nation united, fully prepared against danger –
and so we have [rightly] driven them out of [their] gardens and springs,
and [deprived them of their erstwhile] station of honour!”
Thus it was: but [in the course of time] We were to bestow all these [things] as a heritage on the children of Israel.
And so [the Egyptians] caught up with them at sunrise;

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا تَرٰۤءَا الْجَمْعٰنِ قَالَ اَصْحٰبُ مُوْسٰٓى اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā tarā'al-jam‘āni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamudrakūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and as soon as the two hosts came in sight of one another, the followers of Moses exclaimed: “Behold, we shall certainly be overtaken [and defeated]!”

ayahs.textLatin: Qāla kallā, inna ma‘iya rabbī sayahdīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: He replied: Nay indeed! My Sustainer is with me, [and] He will guide me!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَوْحَيْنَآ اِلٰى مُوْسٰٓى اَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَۗ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa auḥainā ilā mūsā aniḍrib bi‘aṣākal-baḥr(a), fanfalaqa fa kāna kullu firqin kaṭ-ṭaudil ‘aẓīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon We inspired Moses thus: Strike the sea with thy staff!”- whereupon it parted, and each part appeared like a mountain vast.
And We caused the pursuers to draw near unto that place:

ayahs.textLatin: Wa anjainā mūsā wa mam ma‘ahū ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We saved Moses and all who were with him,
and then We caused the others to drown.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this [story] behold, there is a message [unto all men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
And yet, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
And convey unto them the story of Abraham –

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla li'abīhi wa qaumihī mā ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [how it was] when he asked his father and his people, “What is it that you worship?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū na‘budu aṣnāman fa naẓallu lahā ‘ākifīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: We worship idols, and we remain ever devoted to them.”
Said he: “Do [you really think that] they hear you when you invoke them,
or benefit you or do you harm?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ اٰبَاۤءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū bal wajadnā ābā'anā każālika yaf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They exclaimed: But we found our fore­fathers doing the same!”

ayahs.textLatin: Qāla afa ra'aitum mā kuntum ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Abraham]: “Have you, then, ever con­sidered what it is that you have been worshipping
you and those ancient forebears of yours?

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّيْٓ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: “Now [as for me, I know that,] verily, these [false deities] are my enemies, [and that none is my helper] save the Sustainer of all the worlds,
who has created me and is the One who guides me,
and is the One who gives me to eat and to drink,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā mariḍtu fa huwa yasyfīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and when I fall ill, is the One who restores me to health,
and who will cause me to die and then will bring me back to life –

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْٓ اَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لِيْ خَطِيْۤـَٔتِيْ يَوْمَ الدِّيْنِ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażī aṭma‘u ay yagfira lī khaṭī'atī yaumad-dīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and who, [hope, will forgive me my faults on Judgment Day!

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ حُكْمًا وَّاَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbi hab lī ḥukmaw wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “O my Sustainer! Endow me with the ability to judge [between right and wrong], and make me one with the righteous,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِّيْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى الْاٰخِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: and grant me the power to convey the truth unto those who will come after me,
and place me among those who shall inherit the garden of bliss!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِاَبِيْٓ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّاۤلِّيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textEnglish: “And forgive my father - for, verily, he is among those who have gone astray –
and do not put me to shame on the Day when all shall be raised from the dead:

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma lā yanfa‘u māluw wa lā banūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Day on which neither wealth will be of any use, nor children,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَى اللّٰهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيْمٍ ۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: [and when] only he [will be happy] who comes before God with a heart free of evil!”
For, [on that Day,] paradise will be brought within sight of the God-conscious,
whereas the blazing fire will be laid open before those who had been lost in grievous error;

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qīla lahum ainamā kuntum ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and they will be asked: “Where now is all that you were wont to worship

ayahs.textArabic: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗهَلْ يَنْصُرُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Min dūnillāh(i), hal  yanṣurūnakum au yantaṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: instead of God? Can these [things and beings] be of any help to you or to themselves?”
Thereupon they will be hurled into hell – they, as well as all [others] who had been lost in grievous error,
and the hosts of Iblis - all together.
And there and then, blaming one another, they [who had grievously sinned in life] will exclaim:

ayahs.textArabic: تَاللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنَّا لَفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Tallāhi in kunnā lafī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: “By God, we were most obviously astray
when we deemed you [false deities] equal to the Sustainer of all the worlds –
yet they who have seduced us [into believing in you] are the truly guilty ones!
And now we have none to intercede for us,
nor any loving friend.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falau anna lanā karratan fa nakūna minal-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Would that we had a second chance [in life], so that we could be among the believers!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In all this, behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
The people of Noah [too] gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ نُوْحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when their brother Noah said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajr(in), in ajriya illā ‘alā rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
Hence, remain conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!”
They answered: “Shall we place our faith in thee, even though [only] the most abject [of people] follow thee?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِيْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla wa mā ‘ilmī bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said he: “And what knowledge could I have as to what they were doing [before they came to me]?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّيْ لَوْ تَشْعُرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: In ḥisābuhum illā ‘alā rabbī lau tasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Their reckoning rests with none but my Sus­tainer: if you could but understand [this]!
Hence, I shall not drive away [any of] those [who profess to be] believers;
I am nothing but a plain warner.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوْحُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُوْمِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū la'illam tantahi yā nūḥu latakūnanna minal-marjūmīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said they: “Indeed, if thou desist not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be stoned to death!”
[Whereupon] he prayed: “O my Sustainer! Behold, my people have given me the lie:

ayahs.textArabic: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَّنَجِّنِيْ وَمَنْ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faftaḥ bainī wa bainahum fatḥaw wa najjinī wa mam ma‘iya minal-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: hence, lay Thou wide open the truth between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗ فِى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa anjaināhu wa mam ma‘ahū fil-fulkil-masyḥūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We saved him and those [who were] with him in the fully-laden ark,
and then We caused those who stayed behind to drown.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace
[AND the tribe of] Ad gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ هُوْدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when their brother Hud said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
be, then, con­scious of God, and pay heed unto me!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajr(in), in ajriya illā ‘alā rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
“Will you, in your wanton folly, build [idola­trous] altars on every height,
and make for yourselves mighty castles, [hoping] that you might become immortal?
And will you [always], whenever you lay hand [on others], lay hand [on them] cruelly, without any restraint?
“Be, then, conscious of God and pay heed unto me:
and [thus] be conscious of Him who has [so] amply provided you with all [the good] that you might think of
amply provided you with flocks, and children,
and gardens, and springs -:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: for, verily, I fear lest suffering befall you on an awesome day!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْنَآ اَوَعَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْوٰعِظِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū sawā'un ‘alainā awa‘aẓta am lam takum minal-wā‘iẓīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] they answered. “It is all one to us whether thou preachest [something new] or art not of those who [like to] preach.
This [religion of ours] is none other than that to which our forebears clung,
and we are not going to be chastised [for adhering to it]!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُمْۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa każżabūhu fa ahlaknāhum, inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan),  wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so they gave him the lie: and thereupon We destroyed them. In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
[AND the tribe of] Thamud gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-hearers

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when their brother Salih said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajr(in), in ajriya illā ‘alā rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
“Do you think that you will be left secure [forever] in the midst of what you have here and now?
amidst [these] gardens and springs

ayahs.textLatin: Wa zurū‘iw wa nakhlin ṭal‘uhā haḍīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and fields, and [these] palm-trees with slender spathes? –
and that you will [always be able to] hew dwellings out of the mountains with [the same] great skill?”
“Be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me,
and pay no heed to the counsel of those who are given to excesses –

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ يُفْسِدُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yufsidūna fil-arḍi wa lā yaṣliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: those who spread corruption on earth instead of setting things to rights!”
Said they: “Thou art but one of the be­witched!

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَاۙ فَأْتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā anta illā basyarum miṡlunā, fa'ti bi'āyatin in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thou art nothing but a mortal like our­selves! Come, then, forward with a token [of thy mission] if thou art a man of truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla hāżihī nāqatul lahā syirbuw wa lakum syirbu yaumim ma‘lūm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Replied he: “This she-camel shall have a share of water, and you shall have a share of water, on the days appointed [therefor];

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tamassūhā bisū'in fa ya'khużakum ‘ażābu yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and do her no harm, lest suffering befall you on an awesome day!”
But they cruelly slaughtered her - and then they had cause to regret it:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażahumul-‘ażāb(u), inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan), wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for the suffering [predicted by Salih,] befell them [then and there]. In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone – is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
[AND] the people of Lot gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ لُوْطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when their brother Lot said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illā ‘alā rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.
“Must you, of all people, [lustfully] approach men,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَذَرُوْنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْۗ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tażarūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum, bal antum qamun ‘ādūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: keeping yourselves aloof from all the [lawful] spouses whom your Sustainer has created for you? Nay, but you are people who transgress all bounds of what is right!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰلُوْطُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū la'illam tantahi yā lūṭu latakūnanna minal-mukhrajīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said they: “Indeed, If thou desist not, O Lot, thou wilt most certainly be expelled [from this town­ship]!”
[Lot] exclaimed: “Behold, I am one of those who utterly abhor your doings!”

ayahs.textLatin: Rabbi najjinī wa ahlī mimmā ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And then he prayed:] “O my Sustainer! Save me and my household from all that they are doing!”
Thereupon We saved him and all his household –
all but an old woman, who was among those that stayed behind;
and then We utterly destroyed the others,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَاۤءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim maṭarā(n), fa sā'a maṭarul-munżarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and rained down upon them a rain [of destruction]: and dire is such rain upon all who let themselves be warned [to no avail]!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan),  wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not be­lieve [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
[AND] the dwellers of the wooded dales [of Madyan] gave the lie to [one of God’s] message-bearers

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla lahum syu‘aibun alā tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: when their brother Shu’ayb said unto them: “Will you not be conscious of God?
Behold, I am an apostle [sent by Him] to you, [and therefore] worthy of your trust:
be, then, conscious of God, and pay heed unto me!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā as'alukum ‘alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illā ‘alā rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “And no reward whatever do I ask of you for it: my reward rests with none but the Sustainer of all the worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textEnglish: “[Always] give full measure, and be not among those who [unjustly] cause loss [to others];
and [in all your dealings] weigh with a true balance,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَاۤءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tabkhasun-nāsa asy-yā'ahum wa lā ta‘ṡau fil-arḍi mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and do not deprive people of what is rightfully theirs; and do not act wickedly on earth by spreading corruption,
but be conscious of Him who has created you, just as [He created] those countless generations of old!”
Said they: “Thou art but one of the be­witched,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَاِنْ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā anta illā basyarum miṡlunā wa in naẓunnuka laminal-kāżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for thou art nothing but a mortal like ourselves! And, behold, we think that thou art a consummate liar!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa asqiṭ ‘alainā kisafam minas-samā'i in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Cause, then, fragments of the sky to fall down upon us, if thou art a man of truth!”
Answered [Shu’ayb]: “My Sustainer knows fully well what you are doing.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۗاِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa każżabūhu fa akhażahum ‘ażābu yaumiẓ-ẓullah(ti), innahū kāna ‘ażāba yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they gave him the lie. And thereupon suffering overtook them on a day dark with shadows: and, verily, it was the suffering of an awesome day!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً ۗوَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyah(tan),  wa mā kāna akṡaruhum mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: In this [story], behold, there is a message [unto men], even though most of them will not believe [in it].
But, verily, thy Sustainer - He alone - is almighty, a dispenser of grace!
Now, behold, this [divine writ] has indeed been bestowed from on high by the Sustainer of all the worlds:
trustworthy divine inspiration has alighted with it from on high
upon thy heart, [O Muhammad] so that thou mayest be among those who preach
in the clear Arabic tongue.
And, verily, [the essence of] this [revelation] is indeed found in the ancient books of divine wisdom [as well].

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ اٰيَةً اَنْ يَّعْلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰۤؤُا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yakul lahum āyatan ay ya‘lamahū ‘ulamā'u banī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Is it not evidence enough for them that [so many] learned men from among the children of Israel have recognized this [as true]?
But [even] had We bestowed it from on high upon any of the non-Arabs,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيْهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa qara'ahū ‘alaihim mā kānū bihī mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and had he recited it unto them [in his own tongue], they would not have believed in it.
Thus have We caused this [message] to pass [unheeded] through the hearts of those who are lost in sin:

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰى يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ
ayahs.textEnglish: they will not believe in it till they behold the grievous suffering

ayahs.textLatin: Fa ya'tiyahum bagtataw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: that will come upon them [on resurrection,] all of a sudden, without their being aware [of its approach];
and then they will exclaim, “Could we have a respite?”
Do they, then, [really] wish that Our chas­tisement be hastened on?
But hast thou ever considered [this]: If We do allow them to enjoy [this life] for some years,
and thereupon that [chastisement] which they were promised befalls them –

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يُمَتَّعُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: of what avail to them will be all their past enjoyments?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُوْنَ ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā munżirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And withal, never have We destroyed any community unless it had been warned
and reminded: for, never do We wrong [anyone].
And [this divine writ is such a reminder:] no evil spirits have brought it down:

ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā yambagī lahum wa mā yastaṭī‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, neither does it suit their ends, nor is it in their power [to impart it to man]:
verily, [even] from hearing it are they utterly debarred!

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā tad‘u ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhara fa takūna minal-mu‘ażżabīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, [O man,] do not invoke any other deity side by side with God, lest thou find thyself among those who are made to suffer [on Judgment Day].
And warn [whomever thou canst reach, beginning with] thy kinsfolk,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textEnglish: and spread the wings of thy tenderness over all of the believers who may follow thee;

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّيْ بَرِيْۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa in ‘aṣauka faqul innī barī'um mimmā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but if they disobey thee, say, “I am free of responsibility for aught that you may do!” –
and place thy trust in the Almighty, the Dispenser of Grace,
who sees thee when thou standest [alone],
and [sees] thy behaviour among those who prostrate themselves [before Him]:
for, verily, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ اُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلٰى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيْنُ ۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] shall I tell you upon whom it is that those evil spirits descend?
They descend upon all sinful self-deceivers
who readily lend ear [to every falsehood], and most of whom lie to others as well.
And as for the poets [they, too, are prone to deceive themselves: and so, only] those who are lost in grievous error would follow them.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيْمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara annahum fī kulli wādiy yahīmūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Art thou not aware that they roam confusedly through all the valleys [of words and thoughts],

ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yaf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that they [so often] say what they do not do [or feel]?

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّانْتَصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا ۗوَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَّنْقَلِبُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Illal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa żakarullāha kaṡīraw wantaṣarū mim ba‘di mā ẓulimū, wa saya‘lamul-lażīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabiy yanqalibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Most of them are of this kind] save those who have attained to faith, and do righteous deeds, and remember God unceasingly, and defend them­selves [only] after having been wronged, and [trust in God’s promise that] those who are bent on wrong­doing will in time come to know how evil a turn their destinies are bound to take!
